#392 fix r4.summary:
#392 round 4: the single commit in /tmp/wt-392 is amended (base 61f03b67, still one commit, not pushed). All five fix-list items are fixed, and each one was reproduced on c72ec3a0 first.
(1) Variables that uv or pip read only as a file path (new _INSTALLER_PATH_ONLY_ENV: UV_CONFIG_FILE, UV_PROJECT, UV_WORKING_DIR(ECTORY), SSL_*, PIP_CONFIG_FILE, PIP_TARGET/PREFIX/ROOT/SRC, PIP_CERT/CLIENT_CERT) are now accepted only as absolute paths. No scheme exemption applies, and on Windows the path needs a drive or a UNC share. Measured: uv does not expand '~', so '~/x' is refused. pip does expand '~' for PIP_CERT, PIP_CLIENT_CERT and PIP_SRC, so those are accepted with '~'. The refusal text and the guide (plus the bundled copy) no longer say '(or a URL)'.
(2) The installer cwd now follows the target's origin. resolve_entry_target returns a ResolvedPath or a new extension_catalog.CatalogSpec (a str subclass). install_extension and verify_and_pin run either type in installer-cwd, and run a plain str in the caller's cwd. The neutral_cwd keyword is removed, discover passes the resolver's object on, and update wraps each record.
(3) The model now applies UV_WORKING_DIR (else UV_WORKING_DIRECTORY), then UV_PROJECT (lexical join, a pyproject.toml path means its directory), the same way uv's lib.rs does. A relative UV_CONFIG_FILE is joined to uv's working directory.
(4) Rows added for team-a=, M11, M12, M17 and M33.
(5) The ADR says name-surrogate reparse point. Relative UV_PROJECT, UV_WORKING_DIR(ECTORY), UV_EXCLUDE, PIP_BUILD_CONSTRAINT, PIP_REQUIREMENTS_FROM_SCRIPT and PIP_TARGET/PREFIX/ROOT/SRC are now refused. A limits line names what stays unpoliced.

blocking.title: A named UV_DEFAULT_INDEX (corp=<url>) is refused as a relative path. This breaks a UV_* org pin that worked on 61f03b67
blocking.detail: uv accepts UV_DEFAULT_INDEX=name=url, and uv's per-index credential variables (UV_INDEX_<NAME>_USERNAME/PASSWORD) need that form. aelix lists UV_DEFAULT_INDEX in _INSTALLER_PATH_ENV as a single value (extension_install.py:1797), but strips 'name=' only for UV_INDEX (line 1910). So 'corp=https://…' and 'corp=file:///abs' are refused with rc 2 and the message 'UV_DEFAULT_INDEX holds a relative path' on every discover install and update. That breaks the goal 'UV_* still apply' and is a false diagnosis. The rule was added in round 3, so it is part of this commit compared with its base. Fix: give UV_DEFAULT_INDEX the same named-index strip as UV_INDEX, and add a row for each.

blocking.title: PIP_FIND_LINKS=~/x is refused, but pip expands ~ there. The docstring and ADR-0200 sec 12 say otherwise
blocking.detail: When the expanded path exists, pip expands a leading ~ in find-links (pip/_internal/models/search_scope.py:44, SearchScope.create), and it does so from any working directory, the installer directory included. Head refuses PIP_FIND_LINKS=~/wheels on the pip backend with rc 2 and 'holds a relative path'. Parent installed the org pin. This is the round-4 rule '~ passes only where pip expands it' left incomplete: the lane measured only pip's option parser (cert, client_cert, src). Two texts are false or incomplete. The _TILDE_EXPANDED_ENV comment at extension_install.py:1860 says 'Nowhere else is ~ expanded'. ADR-0200 sec 12 (lines 390-391) says '~/x is relative except where pip expands it (PIP_CERT, PIP_CLIENT_CERT, PIP_SRC)'. Fix: treat PIP_FIND_LINKS like _TILDE_EXPANDED_ENV (pip keeps an unexpanded ~ when the path does not exist, so refuse only then), correct both texts, and add a row.
blocking.evidence: pip-find-links-tilde.txt: head pip backend, discover install and update give rc=2 'PIP_FIND_LINKS holds a relative path ('~/wheels')'. findings.title: [cat 1] pip backend: PIP_FIND_LINKS=file:<relative> passes the relative-path guard and is silently dropped in installer-cwd
findings.detail: _relative_installer_env lets any value with an RFC 3986 scheme pass for a URL-capable variable. pip reads a find-links 'file:wheels' / 'file:./wheels' as the relative path 'wheels' (pip/_internal/index/sources.py build_source -> url_to_path). In installer-cwd that path does not exist, so pip prints a WARNING and ignores it: the org pin is lost and the default index answers, rc 0. This is the silent-drop class the commit says it refuses. The refusal for './wheels' even advises 'Set PIP_FIND_LINKS to an absolute path or a URL.', and 'file:wheels' is the URL spelling that then passes. The uv backend is not affected: uv reads file:wheels as /wheels (p3). Not in the ADR-0255 known-limits list, which names scheme values only for the requirement-file variables and says those fail loudly.
findings.evidence: Script: .omc/probes/392-live/r4cross-claude/p1_pip_findlinks.py (kit.py). Cmd: /tmp/392-work/r4cross/venv-new-uv/bin/python p1_pip_findlinks.py. Setup: PIP_INDEX_URL=file:///<root>/public serves local-ext 1.0 PUBLIC-INDEX; <cwd>/wheels has local-ext 2.0 ORG-PIN. Output (p1_pip_findlinks.out): '[parent pip] PIP_FIND_LINKS=file:wheels discover-install rc=0 origin=ORG-PIN' (update the same); '[new pip] PIP_FIND_LINKS=file:wheels discover-install rc=0 origin=PUBLIC-INDEX | WARNING: Location 'file:wheels' is ignored: it is neither a file nor a directory.' (update the same); file:./wheels is identical. The refusal advice comes from p1c_refusal_advice.out.

findings.title: [cat 1, variant] pip backend: a relative find-links inside pip configuration is silently re-pointed at installer-cwd
findings.detail: The guard checks only environment variables. A relative 'find-links = wheels' inside an absolute PIP_CONFIG_FILE (pip also reads relative paths from its user and global pip.conf against its cwd) used to name <cwd>/wheels. It now names installer-cwd/wheels, which pip ignores with a WARNING before installing from the default index, rc 0. Nothing refuses it and no limit lists it. uv is not affected: it resolves a relative path in uv.toml or UV_CONFIG_FILE against that file's directory (p2: parent and commit fail identically, from ~/.config/uv/wheels and <root>/wheels).

findings.title: [cat 3 + cat 2] pip backend: PIP_FIND_LINKS=~/wheels worked on the parent and is now refused with a false message
findings.detail: pip expands a leading ~ in find-links (pip/_internal/models/search_scope.py lines 44-47, SearchScope.create: normalize_path when the expanded path exists), so the value names the same directory from any cwd. The commit adds tilde expansion only for PIP_CERT, PIP_CLIENT_CERT and PIP_SRC (_TILDE_EXPANDED_ENV) and refuses PIP_FIND_LINKS=~/x with exit 2. False text: (a) the printed refusal says the value 'holds a relative path ... where a relative path names a different file'; (b) the extension_install.py comment at about line 1860 says 'Nowhere else is ~ expanded'; (c) the commit message, review round 4 item 1, says 'pip expands ~ for --cert, --client-cert and --src only'; (d) ADR-0200 at line 391 says '~/x is relative except where pip expands it (PIP_CERT, PIP_CLIENT_CERT, PIP_SRC)'. The round-4 measurement read only pip's option parser, and pip expands find-links later than that.
findings.evidence: Script: p1_pip_findlinks.py, row PIP_FIND_LINKS=~/wheels (~/wheels holds ORG-PIN 2.0). Output: '[parent pip] PIP_FIND_LINKS=~/wheels discover-install rc=0 origin=ORG-PIN' and the same for update; '[new pip] PIP_FIND_LINKS=~/wheels discover-install rc=2 origin=NOT-INSTALLED | Error: PIP_FIND_LINKS holds a relative path ('~/wheels') — refusing to install 'local-ext'. ... where a relative path names a different fil[e]' and the same for update. pip 26.2.1 source read in /tmp/392-work/r4cross/venv-new-pip. uv does not expand ~ (p0_uv_tilde_and_isolated.out: UV_FIND_LINKS=~/wheels -> '<cwd>/~/wheels' on both uv versions), so the refusal is right for uv.

findings.title: [cat 3] Concurrent catalog installs or updates on a fresh or older-text installer-cwd are refused at random (exit 2)
findings.detail: _ensure_sentinel runs stat, then unlink, then os.open(O_CREAT|O_EXCL) with no lock and no retry. When two processes prepare the directory at the same time, one gets FileExistsError, which _prepare_installer_cwd turns into 'cannot prepare aelix's installer directory' and exit 2. This happens on first use and whenever the text in the files differs, for example files an older aelix wrote after an aelix upgrade. In steady state the files match and nothing races. The parent has no installer directory and never fails this way. Severity: low; it needs simultaneous starts.

findings.title: [cat 4] Mutant M1 (no Windows junction branch in _is_link_like) passes all 1126 tests
findings.detail: M1 replaces the st_reparse_tag & NAME_SURROGATE check with False. On Windows, os.lstat of a junction reports a directory: S_ISLNK is false and the tag is MOUNT_POINT. Under M1, catalog_installer_cwd would therefore accept a junction as installer-cwd. It would rewrite the sentinels through the junction (the dir_fd-less branch writes by path) and run the installer in the junction's target. That contradicts the commit's 'a symlink or junction ... is refused'. No test creates a junction: the 392 file makes links only with symlink_to and os.link, so M1 also passes on the Windows CI leg. This finding is argued from that, not run on Windows.
